scores.evidence: All three objectives are can-do statements, and each has 2 or more items with objectiveId, at least one at apply level or above: o1 has q1 (apply) and e1 (analyze); o2 has q2, q3 and e4 (evaluate), plus q0 (predict); o3 has q4 and e5 (apply). o3 is a create objective but is tested by apply-level multiple choice; the create step itself happens in practice-spec.

hook-problem is a concrete scenario in 2 sentences (「ほしかったのは、スマートフォンでボタンがはみ出すのを直すことだけでした」) with no trivia, and s1-example and s3-steps later solve exactly this problem. q0 is ungraded, and each of its distractors encodes a brief misconception (stronger adjectives, Manual mode, /rewind).

Prerequisites name 第1回 and 第2回. The lesson recalls them (「第2回で見た権限モードの1つです」, and q0 brings back Manual and /rewind). Terms are defined before use in s1-defs, s2-defs and s4-defs and match the glossary, and the s1-table jargon now has a gloss for beginners: 「モック（mock、仮の部品）」「ウィジェット（widget、画面の部品）」. One small gap: package.json in q3 is never explained.

measure.mjs prints 「prose 2275 (budget 1,200–2,400) · read 3353 · practice reading 1442 · questions 8 · practice sections 2 · est 20.0 min (must be ≤ 20; estMinutes 20)」, and lint shows 0 warnings. s2 is still crowded with 8 blocks: three definitions, a diagram, the entry list, the version callout, the skip rule and a quiz. s4 adds short glosses for UI/UX, エッジケース, トレードオフ, インターフェース and スキル on top of 仕様 and AskUserQuestion.

s3-steps now has 6 steps, within the contract's 3–6. Each step has a subgoal title and a reason: ex-explore 「ファイルを変えずに調べられます」, ex-plan 「書く前に、進め方を読める形にするためです」, ex-commit 「記録すれば、あとで戻せます」. ex-fix models reading the plan against the stated scope. It goes from the full example straight to practice, with no faded step in between.

Every content section has an inline check, and q1, q2 and q3 ask for application in new contexts. q2 option a (「初めて触るリポジトリで、READMEの誤字」) makes the learner weigh two cues against each other. e5 is fixed: b (「この会話のまま続けて実装して」) and d now encode real misconceptions. However, q4 and e5 both use the s4 example (家計簿アプリの予算), and both keys hinge on the same element (writing to SPEC.md). e5 c (「早めに切り上げて」) also partly clashes with the stem's 「詳しく…掘り下げて」.

Every misconception in the brief appears as a distractor with reasoned feedback of at most 2 sentences: stronger adjectives (q0 a), Manual mode (q0 b, e4 d), /rewind (q0 d, e4 b 「Bashで変えたものや外部への操作を戻せません」), the classifier (e4 c), trusting the plan (q3 c), always planning (q2 b), files already changed (q3 d), and the same conversation or Claude remembering (q4 c, e5 b, e5 d).

s2-flow is a 5-node process diagram whose labels match the text (探索, 計画, 実装, コミット). It shows the 「直したい点がある」 loop back to 計画, the caption states the takeaway (「計画を読み、直してから承認して実装に進む」), and the alt text is descriptive. s1-table and s4-table are 2-column comparisons, and there are no decorative images.

Practice 1 is authentic: a 23-line todo.html with a real bug, a setup comment (「# todo.html を保存してから、次の2行で記録する」) that fixes the order, 7 steps with expect, hint and troubleshoot on ② and ④, a 6-item checklist, and then a model marked 「書いてから見比べましょう」. Practice 2 has the same shape. The hint ladder has 2 levels, not 3, and ps-ask's expect leaves out 「当たり前の質問はしない」, which c2-depth requires.

summary-points (5 points) comes after the exam. summary-next has a reflection prompt (「4つの観点のうち、どれが抜けていたでしょうか」) and a concrete next step to 第4回. There are 7 flashcards, and askTutor offers 3 targeted suggestions.

All three confirmed audit findings are applied. s2-version: 「ターミナルとVS Codeで対話するときは、起動時の指定や設定がなければautoモードで始まります。…Manualモードで始まります」 (matches cross-lesson fact 1). s2-enter-lead: 「主な入り方は3つです」. card-enter: 「主な3つの方法」. The rest matches facts-cc-03 (Ctrl+V and Alt+V, the approval labels, Ctrl+G, the one-sentence diff rule, the official interview prompt, the 3 spec conditions). Blocks are cited and the version is pinned (v2.1.304).

The prose is consistently です・ます and warm (「手で仕様を作ってみましょう」, 「大事なリポジトリでは試さないでください」). Lint finds no banned phrases, and terms such as 参照先 and プランモード stay consistent with the glossary. Detailed wording is left to the ja-editor.
The lesson is jp only and complete. The diagram labels are Japanese, s2-flow has descriptive alt text, the only link uses descriptive text (「autoモードが使えない環境」), and no text is baked into images.

niceToHave: check-quiz e5: the item reuses the s4 scenario (家計簿アプリの予算), so it is not a new context for o3. Change the stem's feature to 「読書記録アプリに、本の貸し出しの機能を足したい。」 and keep the rest of the stem.

check-quiz e5 option c: 「早めに切り上げて」 partly clashes with the stem's 「詳しく…掘り下げて」, so it can be ruled out from the stem alone. Consider md 「質問は、技術的な実装についてだけにして。」 with feedback 「話題を絞ると、画面やエッジケースの判断が仕様に残りません。UI/UXやトレードオフも聞いてもらいます。」.
practice-spec-steps ps-ask: c2-depth requires 「当たり前の質問はしない」, but no step asks for it. Change expect to 「AskUserQuestionと、聞いてほしい話題が3つ以上、「当たり前の質問はしない」が入ります。」.

factual doubt: s3-tip 「説明を求めた人は、任せきりの人より理解度テストの点が高くなりました」 reads as causal, but facts-cc-03 learning-33 describes these as interaction patterns 「linked to」 high or low scores within the AI group. Consider 「説明を求めた人は、任せきりの人より理解度テストの点が高い傾向がありました。」.
s3-steps ex-fix: tell the learner that the constraint written in 3-1 is what makes the mismatch visible. Consider appending 「依頼に範囲を書いておいたので、ずれに気づけます。」.
s3-check q3: package.json is not explained for beginners. Consider 「package.json（使うライブラリを書くファイル）」 at its first use in the stem.

s2-version: the link goes to https://code.claude.com/docs/ja/permission-modes, which the audit fetched but sources[] does not list (cc-permission-modes is the /en/ page). Consider using the /en/ URL so the link matches the cited source.
summary: I did a full review because the scope check exited 1: 17 of 44 blocks changed (39%, over 30%). Sections and objectives are unchanged. The round-1 must-fix on e5 is fixed (its distractors now encode the same-conversation and Claude-remembers misconceptions), s3-steps is down to 6 steps that each give a reason, and every audit finding is applied. No must-fix remains. The most useful next improvement is to move e5 to a new scenario so o3 gets a real transfer item.
